description: Calculate GST for one or more line items. Works out intra-state (CGST+SGST, or CGST+UTGST in UTs) vs inter-state (IGST) from the supplier state and place of supply, handles GST-inclusive prices, cess and round-off, and gives the total in words.

cess_rate.description: Compensation cess in percent, if any

discount.description: Flat discount in rupees for this line

place_of_supply.description: Place of supply: state name, 2-digit code, or buyer GSTIN

prices_include_gst.description: True if the rates already include GST (back-calculate tax)

round_off.description: Round grand total to the nearest rupee (default true)

supplier_state.description: Supplier's state name, 2-digit state code, or GSTIN

name: calculate_gst
title: Calculate GST
